normal.name: GamerBait
normal.text: StarTropics was one of Nintendo's more unique late NES titles and by then devs were maxing out the hardware. Its box art popped on shelves, but it was a rental trap: a needed code was on a letter in the box, and stores lost it. Did your video store burn you too? Did you beat it? #RetroGaming
